text: This might be nothing and I feel a bit daft messaging, but I'm a foster carer and she's only been with us a few weeks, so I don't know what's normal for her yet. Nia is 4 and has a temperature of 37.8. I noticed some tiny dots and wasn't sure, because she's got dark skin and they're hard to make out. So I checked her palms, the soles of her feet and inside her lower eyelids, and there are little pin-prick bleeds under the skin there too. I pressed a glass on the ones on her palm like the leaflet says and they didn't go away. Probably overthinking it, but I'd rather ask.
